# Vendored browser assets

These assets are served locally so the review interface does not depend on a
font or JavaScript CDN.

| Package | Version | License file |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | `leaflet.LICENSE` |
| `@fontsource/manrope` | 5.3.0 | `manrope.LICENSE` |

Manrope includes the Latin WOFF2 files for weights 400, 500, 600, 700, and 800.
Map tiles are requested from OpenStreetMap only when the map view is opened.
